# laravelforge_deployment_webhooks (Resource)

Create a new webhook for the site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_deployment_webhooks" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  server       = 123456
  site         = 123456
  url          = "example-url"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `server` (Number) The server ID
- `site` (Number) The site ID
- `url` (String) The URL of the deployment webhook.

### Optional

- `deployment_webhook` (Number) The deployment webhook ID

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date and time the deployment webhook was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the deployment webhook was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_deployment_webhooks.example my-org/123456/123456/123
```
